description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a hyper‑frame structural block containing thirteen‑tier hyper‑layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [HYPER-NU-1]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HN1
    TIER::LOWER

  [HYPER-NU-2]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HN2
    TIER::MIDLOW

  [HYPER-NU-3]

    POSITION=>FIXED

  [HYPER-NU-7]

    TIER::CROWN

  [HYPER-NU-8]

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire hyperframe‑nu block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
